visibility.label: About visibility
visibility.title: How visibility is calculated
visibility.summary: How close the app is to ranking first for every keyword it tracks, weighted by popularity. 100 means position 1 for all of them, 0 means none was found.
visibility.intro: Each keyword counts in proportion to its popularity, and less the lower it ranks:
visibility.tableCaption: Share of a keyword's popularity counted at each position
visibility.unscored: A keyword without a popularity score yet counts as popularity {value}, and one with popularity 0 does not count. Changes are in points.

shareOfVoice.label: About share of voice
shareOfVoice.title: How share of voice is calculated
shareOfVoice.summary: Your visibility as a share of the visibility of your app and the competitors you track, over the same keywords and on the same day.
shareOfVoice.example: With a visibility of {you} against competitors at {first} and {second}, your share of voice is {share}; against the first alone it is {againstOne}.
shareOfVoice.checkedOnly: Only competitors checked that day count, so adding one does not rewrite earlier days. Non branded leaves out the keywords classed as your brand or a competitor's.
shareOfVoice.readCalculation: Read how share of voice is counted

annotations.removeBody: The marker disappears from the rank history and visibility charts.
annotations.emptyBody: Pin a release, a listing change or the start of a campaign to its day, and the charts draw a line there.
